text: A round cavern glows blue around enormous fungi. Stone paths wind between the beds toward a white gazebo, and a child in a gardener's apron works beside nervous helpers. Black-winged shapes flicker above the paths.

views.text: The bluehouse is unfinished stone and damp soil. Giles Weadley trims fungi under a tired lantern while winged ward pixies watch the paths; a gray-skinned woman waits in the gazebo among scattered bones.
The bluehouse is a radiant garden with luminous caps and a white gazebo. A child tends the court's blooms beneath drifting black butterflies, while an elegant lady waits at the center.
